title: mentha × villosa subvar. exserta
intro: Mentha × villosa subvar. exserta, commonly known as Peppermint, is a natural hybrid of spearmint and watermint plants. The essential oil extracted from this plant has been used for its numerous health benefits, including relieving digestive issues, reducing nausea and headaches, and providing antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, peppermint oil has been found to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic actions, making it a popular remedy for muscle and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of peppermint oil include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
